title: AutoPickupDrops
body:
# AutoPickupDrops

Auto-pickup block drops into inventory.

## Features
- Lightweight and configurable.
- Server-side only.
- Works on Paper/Spigot/Purpur.

## Config (snippet)
```yml
enabled: true
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
